verdict.rationale: Multi-GPU distribution is a fair question for an LLM inference engine, but nothing in the evidence documents splitting inference across multiple GPUs via tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism. The pack shows only single-device GPU acceleration (CUDA/HIP/MUSA kernels) and CPU+GPU hybrid offloading. Hybrid offloading is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism
